rows.ja: 供給元・ソフトウェア・部品
提携・金融・事業上の関係
競合(各社の報告に記載)

relations.text: IntelがDell製品に使われるIntel製CPUについて、特許侵害の主張からDellを補償している(2026年7月、10-Q)
relations.text_en: Intel supplies CPUs used in Dell products and is indemnifying Dell against patent claims over Intel CPUs (July 2026, 10-Q)

source.label: Intel 10-Q
source.quote: Intel is indemnifying Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cisco, Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, and Oracle in connection with Intel CPUs accused of infringing three patents.
source.note: 供給契約の記載ではなく、訴訟の開示から読み取れる関係です。
source.note_en: Inferred from a litigation disclosure, not from a supply-contract statement.

relations.text: MicrosoftがDellを含む主要OEMと販売契約を結んでいる(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Microsoft has OEM distribution agreements with Dell, which pre-installs Microsoft software (FY2025 10-K)

source.label: Microsoft 10-K
source.quote: We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo,
source.note: 2025年度の記載で、2026年度の10-KにはDellの名前がありません。
source.note_en: From the FY2025 filing; the FY2026 10-K does not name Dell.

relations.text: AMDが、Dell Pro商用PCにRyzen AI PROプロセッサーが搭載されると発表(2025年1月6日、AMD発表)
relations.text_en: AMD announced Dell Pro commercial PCs will be powered by AMD Ryzen AI PRO processors (January 6, 2025, AMD press release)

source.label: AMD の発表
source.label_en: AMD press release (Ryzen AI PRO in Dell PCs)
source.quote: Dell Pro commercial PCs will be powered by AMD Ryzen AI PRO processors.

relations.text: AMDとDellが、ケンブリッジ大学のAIスーパーコンピューター「Zenith」と核融合AIシステム「Sunrise」を支援(2026年6月8日、AMD発表)
relations.text_en: AMD and Dell are supporting the University of Cambridge’s Zenith AI supercomputer and Sunrise fusion AI system (June 8, 2026, AMD press release)

source.label: AMD の発表
source.quote: AMD and Dell Technologies are supporting the University of Cambridge's Zenith AI supercomputer and Sunrise fusion AI system

relations.text: MicronがDellのインフラとMicronのAI向けストレージ・メモリー製品(Micron 6550 ION SSDなど)の組み合わせを紹介(2025年5月15日、Micronブログ)
relations.text_en: Micron describes combining Dell infrastructure with Micron AI-ready storage and memory products (e.g., Micron 6550 ION SSD) for data centers (May 15, 2025, Micron blog)

source.label: Micron ブログ
source.quote: By combining Dell's robust infrastructure solutions with Micron’s cutting-edge AI-ready storage and memory products
source.note: 供給契約ではなく、企業ブログでの紹介です。
source.note_en: A company blog post, not a supply contract.

companies.name: IREN
companies.sub: AIクラウド・データセンター

relations.text: IRENがDell Canadaから、GPUと関連製品・サービスを約23億ドルで購入することで合意。2026年後半に段階的に納入(2026年5月、10-Q)
relations.text_en: IREN agreed to buy GPUs and ancillary products and services from Dell Canada for about $2.3B, with delivery in phases in the second half of calendar 2026 (May 2026, 10-Q)

source.label: IREN 10-Q
source.quote: On March 4, 2026, the Group and Dell Canada Inc. (“Dell Canada”) entered into purchase documentation (the “Dell Canada Purchase Agreement”) pursuant to which Dell Canada will supply to the Group GPUs and ancillary products and services
source.note: 契約の当事者は子会社のDell Canada Inc.です。Dell Marketing L.P.との別契約は約12億ドルです。
source.note_en: The contracting entity is the subsidiary Dell Canada Inc.; a separate agreement with Dell Marketing L.P. covers about $1.2B.

relations.text: IRENが年次報告で、AIクラウド向けGPU・ネットワーク・ストレージの限られた供給元の1社としてDell Technologiesを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: IREN lists Dell Technologies among its limited set of hardware suppliers for GPUs, networking and storage used in AI Cloud Services (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: IREN 10-K
source.quote: In particular, we source certain hardware solutions (such as GPUs, networking and storage equipment utilized for AI Cloud Services) from a limited number of suppliers, including NVIDIA, AMD, Dell Technologies, Lenovo, Supermicro, Gigabyte and leading storage and networking providers.

relations.text: IRENがDell Financial Servicesと、GPU発注の一部を対象とする24か月のリース融資を結んだ(2026年5月、10-Q)
relations.text_en: IREN entered financing arrangements with Dell Financial Services for a 24-month lease financing a portion of its GPU orders (May 2026, 10-Q)

source.label: IREN 10-Q
source.quote: On November 5, 2025, the Group entered into financing arrangements with Dell Financial Services to finance a portion of the Group’s GPU orders.
source.note: Dell Financial Servicesは子会社で、枠は1.998億ドルです。
source.note_en: Dell Financial Services is a Dell subsidiary; the facility is $199.8 million.

companies.name: Nutanix
companies.sub: ハイブリッドクラウド・ソフト

relations.text: Nutanixのソフトは認定済みのDellハードウェア(Dell XC)で動作し、Dell PowerFlex・PowerStoreの外部ストレージとも連携する(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Nutanix software runs on qualified Dell hardware (Dell XC) and integrates with Dell PowerFlex and PowerStore external storage (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Nutanix 10-K
source.quote: OEM Partners . Our software can run on qualified hardware from Cisco Systems, Inc. ("Cisco"), Dell Technologies ("Dell"), Fujitsu Technology Solutions GmbH ("Fujitsu"), Hewlett Packard Enterprise ("HPE"), and Lenovo Group Ltd. ("Lenovo")

relations.text: Nutanixが年次報告で、競合する従来型ITシステムベンダーの1社としてDellを挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Nutanix names Dell among traditional IT systems vendors it competes with (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Nutanix 10-K
source.quote: traditional IT systems vendors, such as Dell, Everpure, Inc., Fujitsu, HPE, Hitachi Vantara, Lenovo, Inc., NetApp, Inc., and Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.

relations.text: NVIDIAが、RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU搭載の2U RTX PROサーバーを提供するシステムパートナーの1社としてDell Technologiesを挙げた(2025年8月11日、NVIDIA発表)
relations.text_en: NVIDIA named Dell Technologies among system partners offering 2U RTX PRO servers with RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs (August 11, 2025, NVIDIA press release)

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: Global system partners including Cisco, Dell Technologies , HPE , Lenovo and Supermicro will offer the 2U NVIDIA RTX PRO Servers
source.note: 製品レベルの発表です。

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.sub: 半導体・インフラソフト

relations.text: BroadcomによるVMware買収を受け、DellはVMware製品の販売契約を2024年3月に終了(2026年度、10-K)。VxRailには引き続きVMware製品を組み込んでいる
relations.text_en: Dell terminated its VMware distribution agreement after Broadcom acquired VMware, but still embeds VMware products in its VxRail solution (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: Dell Technologies 10-K
source.quote: In March 2024, following the acquisition of VMware by Broadcom, we terminated our Commercial Framework Agreement with VMware, whereby we acted as a distributor of VMware standalone products and services.
source.note: 関係はほぼ解消済みです。VxRailでの組み込みと、分離上場に伴う税の補償が残ります。
source.note_en: The relationship is largely wound down; VxRail integration and spin-off tax indemnities remain.

relations.text: Broadcomが、2021年のVMware分離がDellの非課税扱いにならなかった場合、Dellの税負担を補償する可能性があると開示(2026年9月10日、10-Q)
relations.text_en: Broadcom discloses it may have to indemnify Dell for tax liabilities if the 2021 VMware spin-off from Dell fails to qualify as tax-free (September 2026, 10-Q)

source.label: Broadcom 10-Q
source.quote: Dell, its affiliates and, potentially, its stockholders would incur significant tax liabilities and we may be required to indemnify Dell and its affiliates for any such tax liabilities
source.note: 条件付きの補償のみです。

companies.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
companies.sub: サーバー・ネットワーク

relations.text: Hewlett Packard Enterpriseが年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Hewlett Packard Enterprise names Dell as a competitor in its FY2025 10-K

source.label: HPE 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors in data center infrastructure are technology vendors, such as Dell Technologies Inc., Super Micro Computer, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., and Lenovo Group Ltd.

relations.text: HP Inc.が年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: HP Inc. names Dell as a competitor in its FY2025 10-K

source.label: HP Inc. 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors are Acer Inc., Apple Inc., ASUSTeK Computer Inc., Dell Inc., Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd., Lenovo Group Limited

relations.text: Super Micro Computerが年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Super Micro Computer names Dell as a competitor in its FY2026 10-K

source.label: Super Micro 10-K
source.quote: We believe our principal competitors include: • global technology vendors, such as Cisco, Dell, Hewlett-Packard Enterprise, and Lenovo

relations.text: Cisco Systemsが年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Cisco Systems names Dell as a competitor in its FY2026 10-K

relations.text: IBMが年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: IBM names Dell as a competitor in its FY2025 10-K

source.label: IBM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include: Dell Technologies, Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE), Intel, NetApp and Pure Storage

relations.text: Pure Storage(Everpure)が年次報告で、Dell Technologiesを競合として挙げている(2026年9月、10-Q)
relations.text_en: Pure Storage (Everpure) names Dell as a competitor in its September 2026 10-Q

source.label: Pure Storage 10-Q
source.quote: We face intense competition from a number of established companies that sell competing storage products, including Dell EMC, HP Enterprise

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
